name: api-musket
description: The public weapons API (D-097) used like another mod would: GunPowderedApi.Musket.SetLoaded / GetLoaded keep the load inside 0..5 and the shot uses it; ShotFired reports every shot with the cartridges left, and a listener that throws does not stop the shot.

steps.label: empty backpack, the Iron Musket equipped

steps.name: GunPowdered.apiSetLoaded
steps.label: the API keeps the load at most 5

steps.name: GunPowdered.musketPress
steps.label: the shot uses the load the API set (a failing listener does not stop it)

steps.name: GunPowdered.apiShots
steps.expect: 1 shot(s), last left 1, 1 expected listener warning(s)
steps.label: the event reported the shot

steps.name: GunPowdered.apiShots
steps.expect: 2 shot(s), last left 0, 2 expected listener warning(s)
steps.label: and the second
